label: Left Pointed Patch Pocket
description: A pointed patch back pocket is sewn onto the outside of the seat with a shaped, pointed bottom edge, the casual style seen on jeans and chinos. Being applied on top of the cloth it is the most informal and visible back pocket, often topstitched for emphasis. It signals workwear and casual heritage rather than tailoring.
